lines.x: 当年帮凯尔希做过的事，也不是不能帮你做。凡是生物样本，甭管昆虫、草籽还是十几米长的顶级掠食者，我都能给你带来。怎么带……谁教你这么问问题的？

Here, take it—'premium feed.' Those biologists gave it to me, and it turns my stomach just looking at it. Every last one of them begs me to tell them about the insects I saw back then, and the moment I do, they nod off. Says they're writing a 'great work of entomology,' and they don't care about taste or texture. What exactly are they writing?
凯尔希还四脚着地的时候，可没这么郁闷，怎么回事？我当初才花十五年就领会了完美的鸡生，她又多折腾了这么些年，怎么反而……你说，我是不是该从现在开始帮她研究猫科完美食谱？

What do you mean, your Originium? Once I've swallowed it, it's my gizzard stone. It aids digestion—very important, thank you. Hey, hey, hey, what are you doing? I'm telling you, this hut of mine works like a piggy bank: the only way to get anything out is to smash it. You wouldn't do that to me over a few lousy rocks, would you?
是吗，凯尔希是为了救你才死的？那个在我被样本追得满地乱跑的时候也只会说“扫描中，进度50%”的凯尔希，知道救人？是你把她变成这样的吗，还是……是她自己？哼，那就好。

You've got Closure hidden in here, haven't you? She still owes me at least ten refits—she doesn't get to run off. Tch, the balance just isn't tuned yet, no need to lecture me. I've already lost my beak; am I really not allowed hydraulic pincers, a bumper, a flamethrower and a propeller on top of that?

Stop introducing me to fowlbeasts. I have nothing whatsoever to do with those Terran natives—at best we're products of convergent evolution. If you actually cared about my well-being in that department, you'd find something egg-shaped and put it in my hut instead. That kettle of yours looks about right, don't you think?
Bwaak—bwak bwak—bwaaak—

So you're the leader of these humans? Then go deal with that 'HR Operator' outside—she insists on writing my race down as 'Liberi.' I've said it ten thousand times: I am a chicken. A junglefowl. Is that so hard to grasp?
You're telling me they go to all that trouble neither to feed nor to court a mate? Just like Kal'tsit, then.
Why is everyone so tall! Move, move—I can't see where I'm going.
You, you, you, and you—charge in. The louder the better. That's the plan.
Kal'tsit, let's move!
Do all humans look the same? A serious step backward for evolution.
Back when I fetched samples for Kal'tsit, I did it all my own way.
Surely you've got something more important to do than order a chicken about?
你们人类选窝的眼光，我还真是不敢恭维啊……
It's not like I'm brooding eggs—why do I have to sit here without moving?
(Crows furiously while flapping what feathers remain)
Do I really look that unappetizing now? Sigh.
Oho, can't even catch a chicken that's over ten thousand years old?
You lot were scarier back when you still had fur.
See that? The chicken remains this planet's ruler after all.
你们该研究的都研究完了吧，样本我吃了啊……不行？我一只鸡管你们什么人道主义？
They're fleeing at about the speed of a worm crawling—and you can stop yourselves from chasing?
Kal'tsit, do something, I'm dying here!
Are houses that can run some sort of trend these days?
Don't grab the hood? Too bad, my claws are itching.
Yes, yes, the weathervane is ever so much fun. And my tail? Is it really that boring?
Arknights.

A scone? Er, I just ate the last one. No matter, hold on— Bwak, cough cough, bwaak— There. Here you go, eat up. What's that face for? It only brushed against my interior lining a little; I didn't digest it. Hurry up and eat it!
Pinch my pinfeathers.

A birthday? Is that the day the egg was laid, or the day I broke out of the shell? Ha, don't tie yourself in knots—I don't know either date. And I don't need to know whether your birthday is the day you were born or the day you woke up as the Doctor. As long as it's a day I can bring you a sandworm leg, it'll do.

The last chicken, the last human—ha, that does sound heavy. But the chickens that died and were buried and turned into Liberi long ago are none of my business; I only answer to Kal'tsit. And you? Must you really worry on everyone's behalf? At least once in a while, couldn't you answer to just one person?
